observations: Three photos show a large office printer wrapped in plastic, placed on a wooden shelf.
The printer has a black front panel with 'KONICA MINOLTA' and 'bizhub c3351' printed in white text.
The top section is beige or cream-colored, with a sticker that says 'THE ONLINE TRAINING FOR YOUR bizhub' and a QR code.
The printer appears to be in a storage or warehouse setting, surrounded by other wrapped items and cardboard boxes.
No power cord, paper tray, or toner cartridge is visible in any photo.
The printer is not shown in operation; no lights or indicators are visible.

claims.evidence: The brand and model are clearly visible on the front panel in all three photos.
The photos show a printer, but there is no visual proof of color printing, A4 paper output, or all-in-one functionality. The term 'workhorse' is subjective and not verifiable from images.

risks.risk: Printer may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on, printing a test page, and operating the scanner or copier functions.

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as power cord, paper tray, toner, or scanner glass
risks.proof: Photos showing the power cord, paper tray, toner cartridge, and scanner glass.

risks.risk: Printer may be used or refurbished without disclosure
risks.proof: Photos of the serial number and any wear or damage on the casing, or a receipt or service history.

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker with the model number, usually inside the original packaging.
Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photos of the power cord, paper tray, toner cartridge, and scanner glass.
Photo of the serial number and any wear or damage on the casing.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
